name: callimachus-mcp
stderr:
callimachus-mcp: the prebuilt Linux binary needs glibc 2.38 or newer (Ubuntu 24.04+, Debian 13+, Fedora 39+), but this system has glibc 2.36.
Building from source doesn't get around this: the ONNX Runtime it links has the same glibc 2.38 floor. Use a newer distro, or run callimachus-mcp in a container based on one (the repo's Dockerfile builds it on Debian 13), with CALLIMACHUS_DB pointing at your mounted index.db.
